bullets.text: sorting a bag that got rained on. everything is fine, everything is slightly heavier.
duck at hashimoto. rain on the river, cedars leaning uphill like they already know where this ends. 🌧️
a vending machine under an awning selling hot coffee in july. the slot was warm. somebody had bought one.
damp all the way through. not cold. wet long enough that it stops being an event.
the river does not get wetter. the rain keeps arriving anyway.
